questions.question: What is teamwork, and how does a good leader work with a team?
questions.expected_answer: Teamwork is when a group of people work together towards the same goal, each doing their part and helping each other. A good leader brings people together, listens to their ideas, gives each person a job, shares the praise and does not blame others when things go wrong.

questions.question: What does courage mean? Give an example of a brave leader.
questions.expected_answer: Courage means doing what is right even when you are afraid, or when it is hard or unpopular. Helen Suzman bravely spoke against apartheid laws in Parliament for thirteen years as the only member of her party. Lilian Ngoyi bravely led the women's march of 1956.

questions.question: Give one example of everyday courage at school.
questions.expected_answer: Telling a teacher that someone is being bullied, sitting with a learner who is ignored, answering a question when you are unsure, or saying no when friends want to do something wrong.
